author: skellyboi730
body:
Okay, I'm here to appeal/apologize for my name but I have questions
I don't understand how ANYONE can be offended by my name - how and who can it possibly insult
my name at first was intended to make people laugh and a compliment to myself
WHO was offended by this name?
Why did I necessarily have to be banned, why can't I be muted until my name can be available again
its just not fair. There is an explanation required for this as I am certainly confused.

I came to say sorry, and was wondering if I could be a granted a less brutal punishment but also be able to play with my friends
I think we should sort this out properly like using a command  that can cover my name temporarily.
I personally find it strange that people decide to be offended by my name when there previously have been worse names
like CaptainNoNipples.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Morby,

We're not saying that people are offended by your name; we're saying that it's not an appropriate name for the family-friendly server that we are.

We don't mute and we don't offer ways to censor your name. Your username is up to yourself. 

This appeal is denied, and we will not be appealing this punishment unless the username is changed to something appropriate before it expires.
